entries.title: Genesis 27:1
segments: ¶Now it came to pass, when Isaac was old and his eyes were so dim that he could not see, that he called Esau his older son and said to him, "My son." And he answered him, "Here I am."

entries.title: Genesis 27:2
segments: Then he said, "Behold now, I am old. I do not know the day of my death.

entries.title: Genesis 27:3
segments: "Now therefore, please take your weapons, your quiver and your bow, and go out to the field and hunt game for me.

entries.title: Genesis 27:4
segments: "And make me savory food, such as I love, and bring [it] to me that I may eat, that my soul may bless you before I die."

entries.title: Genesis 27:5
segments: Now Rebekah was listening when Isaac spoke to Esau his son. And Esau went to the field to hunt game and to bring [it].

entries.title: Genesis 27:6
segments: ¶So Rebekah spoke to Jacob her son, saying, "Indeed I heard your father speak to Esau your brother, saying,

entries.title: Genesis 27:7
segments: 'Bring me game and make savory food for me, that I may eat it and bless you in the presence of the LORD before my death.'

entries.title: Genesis 27:8
segments: "Now therefore, my son, obey my voice according to what I command you.

entries.title: Genesis 27:9
segments: "Go now to the flock and bring me from there two choice kids of the goats, and I will make savory food from them for your father, such as he loves.

entries.title: Genesis 27:10
segments: "Then you shall take [it] to your father, that he may eat [it], and that he may bless you before his death."

entries.title: Genesis 27:11
segments: And Jacob said to Rebekah his mother, "Look, Esau my brother [is] a hairy man, and I [am] a smooth-[skinned] man.

entries.title: Genesis 27:12
segments: "Perhaps my father will feel me, and I shall seem to be a deceiver to him; and I shall bring a curse on myself and not a blessing."

entries.title: Genesis 27:13
segments: But his mother said to him, "[Let] your curse [be] on me, my son; only obey my voice, and go, get [them] for me."

entries.title: Genesis 27:14
segments: And he went and got [them] and brought [them] to his mother, and his mother made savory food, such as his father loved.

entries.title: Genesis 27:15
segments: Then Rebekah took the choice clothes of her elder son Esau, which [were] with her in the house, and put them on Jacob her younger son.

entries.title: Genesis 27:16
segments: And she put the skins of the kids of the goats on his hands and on the smooth part of his neck.

entries.title: Genesis 27:17
segments: Then she gave the savory food and the bread, which she had prepared, into the hand of her son Jacob.

entries.title: Genesis 27:18
segments: ¶So he went to his father and said, "My father.' And he said, "Here I am. Who [are] you, my son?"

entries.title: Genesis 27:19
segments: Jacob said to his father, "I [am] Esau your firstborn; I have done just as you told me; please arise, sit and eat of my game, that your soul may bless me."

entries.title: Genesis 27:20
segments: But Isaac said to his son, "How [is it] that you have found [it] so quickly, my son?" And he said, "Because the LORD your God brought [it] to me."

entries.title: Genesis 27:21
segments: Then Isaac said to Jacob, "Please come near, that I may feel you, my son, whether you [are] really my son Esau or not."

entries.title: Genesis 27:22
segments: So Jacob went near to Isaac his father, and he felt him and said, "The voice [is] Jacob's voice, but the hands [are] the hands of Esau."

entries.title: Genesis 27:23
segments: And he did not recognize him, because his hands were hairy like his brother Esau's hands; so he blessed him.

entries.title: Genesis 27:24
segments: Then he said, "[Are] you really my son Esau?" He said, "I [am]."

entries.title: Genesis 27:25
segments: He said, "Bring [it] near to me, and I will eat of my son's game, so that my soul may bless you." So he brought [it] near to him, and he ate; and he brought him wine, and he drank.

entries.title: Genesis 27:26
segments: Then his father Isaac said to him, "Come near now and kiss me, my son."

entries.title: Genesis 27:27
segments: And he came near and kissed him; and he smelled the smell of his clothing, and blessed him and said: "Surely, the smell of my son [Is] like the smell of a field Which the LORD has blessed.

entries.title: Genesis 27:28
segments: Therefore may God give you Of the dew of heaven, Of the fatness of the earth, And plenty of grain and wine.

entries.title: Genesis 27:29
segments: Let peoples serve you, And nations bow down to you. Be master over your brethren, And let your mother's sons bow down to you. Cursed [be] everyone who curses you, And blessed [be] those who bless you!"

entries.title: Genesis 27:30
segments: ¶Now it happened, as soon as Isaac had finished blessing Jacob, and Jacob had scarcely gone out from the presence of Isaac his father, that Esau his brother came in from his hunting.

entries.title: Genesis 27:31
segments: He also had made savory food, and brought it to his father, and said to his father, "Let my father arise and eat of his son's game, that your soul may bless me."

entries.title: Genesis 27:32
segments: And his father Isaac said to him, "Who [are] you?" So he said, "I [am] your son, your firstborn, Esau."

entries.title: Genesis 27:33
segments: Then Isaac trembled exceedingly, and said, "Who? Where [is] the one who hunted game and brought [it] to me? I ate all [of it] before you came, and I have blessed him-[and] indeed he shall be blessed."

entries.title: Genesis 27:34
segments: When Esau heard the words of his father, he cried with an exceedingly great and bitter cry, and said to his father, "Bless me-me also, O my father!"

entries.title: Genesis 27:35
segments: But he said, "Your brother came with deceit and has taken away your blessing."

entries.title: Genesis 27:36
segments: And [Esau] said, "Is he not rightly named Jacob? For he has supplanted me these two times. He took away my birthright, and now look, he has taken away my blessing!" And he said, "Have you not reserved a blessing for me?"

entries.title: Genesis 27:37
segments: Then Isaac answered and said to Esau, "Indeed I have made him your master, and all his brethren I have given to him as servants; with grain and wine I have sustained him. What shall I do now for you, my son?"

entries.title: Genesis 27:38
segments: And Esau said to his father, "Have you only one blessing, my father? Bless me-me also, O my father!" And Esau lifted up his voice and wept.

entries.title: Genesis 27:39
segments: Then Isaac his father answered and said to him: "Behold, your dwelling shall be of the fatness of the earth, And of the dew of heaven from above.

entries.title: Genesis 27:40
segments: By your sword you shall live, And you shall serve your brother; And it shall come to pass, when you become restless, That you shall break his yoke from your neck."

entries.title: Genesis 27:41
segments: ¶So Esau hated Jacob because of the blessing with which his father blessed him, and Esau said in his heart, "The days of mourning for my father are at hand; then I will kill my brother Jacob."

entries.title: Genesis 27:42
segments: And the words of Esau her older son were told to Rebekah. So she sent and called Jacob her younger son, and said to him, "Surely your brother Esau comforts himself concerning you [by intending] to kill you.

entries.title: Genesis 27:43
segments: "Now therefore, my son, obey my voice: arise, flee to my brother Laban in Haran.

entries.title: Genesis 27:44
segments: "And stay with him a few days, until your brother's fury turns away,

entries.title: Genesis 27:45
segments: "until your brother's anger turns away from you, and he forgets what you have done to him; then I will send and bring you from there. Why should I be bereaved also of you both in one day?"

entries.title: Genesis 27:46
segments: And Rebekah said to Isaac, "I am weary of my life because of the daughters of Heth; if Jacob takes a wife of the daughters of Heth, like these [who are] the daughters of the land, what good will my life be to me?"
